'''2012 Bespin Regionals Mark Peterson LS We'll Handle This (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Lukes Bionic Hand
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
